corroboration.scope: Exact current client identities and chance wording agree with the published item descriptions. These are related evidence, not independent experimental measurements.

exceptions: Refined Grain Juice is deliberately excluded: parent568 places the chance paragraph after Concentrated Grain Juice conversion, while native byproduct relationships attach it to Special grain. This conflict is not settled by a generic hint.
Other timber, metals, hides and gems are not inferred from the Iron Ingot example.
No exact byproduct rates, output count distribution, individual herb/grain eligibility or universal skill threshold certified.
Processing raw success fields are not byproduct proc probabilities.

relatedEligibilityResolution.decision: The Guru1 exchange restriction was explicitly removed. Existing unrestricted acquisition wording is correct. Separate Purified Lightstone residence Alchemy retains Guru1; regression checked in all modes.
